Routed the claudenative review FAIL (reviews/claudenative.json at 58fdc56). Fix Run wf_56e12a0f-68f: branch cc-sync/claudenative-fixes from origin/cc-sync/claudenative, worktree /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/cc-sync/claudenative-fixes, hand-authored synthetic fixtures only. Fixes:
- (1) Exact enqueue semantics: an enqueue→dequeue→resulting-record chain takes the resulting record's origin, so a task-notification or peer is autonomous.
- (2)/(3) Boundary-digest cursors so same-inode, same-size rewrites of transcripts and history.jsonl force a reparse.
- (4) Per-scan cheap stats of the known sidecar roots, so sidecar-only creation/deletion is discovered without transcript changes or recursive walks.
- (5) Pure-metadata system/attachment subtypes (prompt_snapshot, compact_boundary, environment, etc.) are ActivityNone. The rule is documented on ClassifyRecord.
The fix is then verified by astra against each reproduction, then refixed if needed. It merges into cc-sync/integration in phase 2; phase 1 (Run wf_c798388b-ea8) builds on the pre-fix claudenative API, which the fixes keep stable.

D7 clarification adopted into delta doc 64803ab:
- A mixed checkpoint (newer sessions + deferred/older code) is PARTIAL/NOT READY. Default pickup and ACK readiness use COMPLETE grouped checkpoints only.
- list/picker show the latest complete checkpoint as the pick-up target, plus a visible "newer partial checkpoint (code deferred: reason, code age, session age)" line.
- A mixed checkpoint is restorable only with an explicit `--checkpoint <id> --allow-partial` (JSON partial:true; never default or auto-selected).
- Required test: a new transcript turn after Deferred/Partial/MissingLFS code capture.
- The phase-1 wiring lanes (capture, pickup, service) start after merge1 and read the updated delta. The catalog readiness/ACK semantics get verified in merge2.
